decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2758-01 Rev P2, 2758-02 Rev P2, received on 04/03/2013 and 2758-03 Rev P and 2758-04 Rev P6, received on 25/04/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The window formed in the south elevation shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and single storey rear extension to the house.
